name: Noise
description: Random, organic brightness. Each unit steps between random levels inside a range (drag the range in the history); the spread decides who shares a value (All the same: the whole rig, Fixture by fixture: every fixture, Spatial 2D / Within: every pixel). Frequency sets how often a value is bright (the share above half: low = mostly dark with an occasional flash, high = mostly bright with dips), Variation how soft the values are (0 = on/off: above half → highest, below → lowest; 1 = soft levels), Coherence goes from independent units to soft patches (Spatial 2D: the handle length sets their size, its direction where they drift), Sync from free timing to on the beat, Hardness from soft blends to hard jumps.
purpose: Fixtures flicker, sparkle or pick at random.

params.label: Frequency
params.description: How often it is bright: the share of values above half (0 = rarely, 1 = almost always; 0.5 = even).

params.label: Variation
params.description: On/off (0: above half goes to the highest level, below to the lowest) to soft levels (1).

params.label: Coherence
params.description: Independent (0) to soft patches (1): neighbours follow each other, evenly in every direction.

params.label: Sync
params.description: Free timing (0) to everything stepping on the beat (1).

params.label: Hardness
params.description: Soft blends (0) to hard jumps (1), also for the peaks.

presets.label: Candle
presets.description: A warm, restless glow, fixture by fixture.

presets.label: Twinkle
presets.description: Dim pixels, now and then one sparkles.

presets.label: Random Pick
presets.description: Mostly dark; on each beat about a quarter of the fixtures is on.

presets.label: Fire
presets.description: Flickering patches of light drifting along the handle.

presets.label: Water
presets.description: Slow, soft patches drifting over the area.

presets.label: Faulty
presets.description: Full brightness, now and then a fixture drops out.

presets.label: Lightning
presets.description: The whole rig stays dark and flashes now and then.
